name: asklilowl
description: Turns lessons created by ChatGPT into interactive, audience-aware slides and quizzes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn explanations into interactive lessons and quizzes.
interface.longDescription: AskLilOwl renders complete, audience-aware lessons created in the active ChatGPT conversation as interactive slides with optional educational images, learning objectives, sources, and a comprehension quiz.
defaultPrompt: Teach my child how birds fly with a short quiz.
Explain database indexes as an interactive lesson.
Research a current topic and teach it with sources.
